verdict.rationale: Phaser's UI products (Phaser Editor and the hosted Game Agent) are backed by an official MCP server with over 40 specialised tools, so agents can perform many editor actions programmatically, such as creating particle emitters, reorganising layers and renaming objects. Nothing documents that this tool set matches everything the UI can do, and no REST or OpenAPI surface was found (all OpenAPI probes returned 404). missing for 10: documented API/UI parity claim or a tool-coverage map against editor features, a general REST/OpenAPI API for the editor and agent, independent hands-on confirmation of coverage depth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: For power users, the MCP Server goes deeper. It implements over 40 specialised tools and integrates directly with Claude Desktop, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and other MCP-compatible tools.
Create a particle emitter, reorganise a scene into layers, rename a bunch of objects — it handles it without switching tools.
You describe what you want in plain language and your agent calls the tools for you.
